use_internal_dhcp_client.description: Enable or disable the internal DHCP client (recommended for most setups).

use_internal_dns_server.description: Enable or disable the internal DNS resolver (required if not using external DNS).

enable_ipv6.description: Enable or disable IPv6 support on wireless connections.

max_connected_networks.description: Maximum number of networks that can be connected simultaneously.

scan_interval.description: Seconds between automatic background scans (set higher to reduce power usage).

association_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for network association before failing.

dhcp_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for DHCP configuration before failing.

dns_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for DNS resolution before failing.

eap_tls_certificate_path.description: Path to directory containing EAP-TLS certificates (ca.pem, client.pem, client.key). Leave empty to disable.

eap_tls_private_key_password.description: Password for encrypted EAP-TLS client private key (leave empty if not encrypted).

networks.description: List of pre-configured networks to auto-connect to.

name.description: Network name (SSID). Required. Use 'Hidden' as prefix for hidden networks (e.g., 'Hidden:MySSID').

password.description: Pre-shared key (WPA2/WPA3-PSK). Required for 'psk' or 'sae' security (if not using SAE-specific field).

sae_password.description: Explicit SAE (WPA3) password. Overrides 'password' when using SAE.

eap_method.description: EAP method for 802.1x: 'PEAP', 'TTLS', 'TLS', etc. Required for '8021x' security.

identity.description: User identity (e.g., username) for PEAP/TTLS. Required for most EAP methods except TLS.

anonymous_identity.description: Anonymous identity (e.g., anonymous@example.com) for PEAP/TTLS tunnel negotiation.

ca_certificate.description: Path to CA certificate file (e.g., /etc/ssl/certs/ca.pem). Required for PEAP/TTLS server verification.

client_certificate.description: Path to client certificate file (required for EAP-TLS).

client_private_key.description: Path to client private key file (required for EAP-TLS).

background_scan.description: Enable background scanning to automatically reconnect to this network.

frequency_band.description: Preferred frequency band: 'any', '2ghz', or '5ghz'. Helps steer to preferred band.
